description: Simulated grouped data for the cluster-robust leaf covariances: 36 schools of 8 to 40 pupils with school-level random intercepts, a planted split at z1 = 5, and responses for poisson (y_pois, offset log(exposure)), negative binomial (y_nb), multinomial (y_mn) and safe logit without separation (y_sl). The column school holds the cluster id.
generator_code:
{
    g <- 36L
    school <- rep(seq_len(g), sample(8:40, g, replace = TRUE))
    n <- length(school)
    zs <- runif(g, 0, 10)
    zt <- factor(sample(c("urban", "rural", "peri"), g, replace = TRUE))
    u <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.5)[school]
    um <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.5)[school]
    uh <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.5)[school]
    d <- data.frame(school = school, x = rnorm(n), zs = zs[school], zt = zt[school], z1 = runif(n, 0, 
        10), z2 = factor(sample(c("a", "b", "c"), n, replace = TRUE)), z3 = rnorm(n), exposure = runif(n, 
        0.5, 2))
    left <- d$z1 <= 5
    eta <- u + ifelse(left, 0.2 + 0.7 * d$x, 0.9 - 0.4 * d$x)
    d$y_pois <- rpois(n, d$exposure * exp(eta))
    d$y_nb <- rnbinom(n, mu = d$exposure * exp(eta), size = 2)
    em <- um + ifelse(left, 0.3 + 0.8 * d$x, -0.5 - 0.5 * d$x)
    eh <- uh + ifelse(left, -0.2 - 0.6 * d$x, 0.6 + 1 * d$x)
    p <- cbind(1, exp(em), exp(eh))
    p <- p/rowSums(p)
    v <- runif(n)
    lev <- c("lo", "mid", "hi")
    d$y_mn <- factor(lev[1L + (v > p[, 1L]) + (v > p[, 1L] + p[, 2L])], levels = lev)
    d$y_sl <- as.integer(runif(n) < plogis(u + ifelse(left, -0.5 + 1.2 * d$x, 0.5 - 0.8 * d$x)))
    d[sample(n), ]
}
